sentences.text: Petitioner, filed the aforementioned writ petition, complaining the action of respondents in not paying enhanced compensation in terms of judgment and decree passed in LAAS No.67 of 2022 in LAOP No.111 of 1991 on the file of Senior Civil Judge, Gudur.

The writ petition was disposed of directing the respondents to deposit the amount payable to the petitioners to the credit of E.P.No.65 of 2023 in LAOP No.111 of 1991 on the file of Senior Civil Judge, Gudur, within 10 weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of the order.
3. When the contempt case was listed on 20.09.2024, Smt.A.Jayanthi, learned counsel for the lst respondent submitted that the amount will be deposited within 4 months and the same was recorded.
An affidavit was filed to that effect.
4. Again the contempt case was taken up for hearing on 08.ll.2024.
Given the reply filed by the lst respondent on 15.ll.2024 that the Government will pay the compensation to the petitioner within 4 months and the contempt case was adjourned to o3.ll.2025.

5. Again the contempt case was taken up for consideration on 14.02.2025, Smt.A.Jayanthi, learned counsel for lSt respondent and Ms.Vasavi, learned counsel for 2nd respondent, seek further time to deposit the amount.
An affidavit dated 21.02.2025 was also filed, later, seeking 2 more months time to deposI-I the amount.
6. Two more months time sought by the lst respondent, as per the affidavit, was completed by 21.04.2025.
Still the amount has not been deposited.
Thus, the respondents failed to comply with the order dated 08-05.2024 in W.P.No-5997 of 2024.

7. At this stage, SmtlA.Jayanthj, learned counsel for lSt respondent, Sri Nagaraju Naguru, learned counsel for 2nd respondent and Sri Bhagat Singh, learned counsel representing sri K.M.Krishna Reddy, learned counsel for respondents 3 to 5, seek one more chance to comply with the order.
I 8. At request, list the matter on 18.06.2025.
If the amount is not deposl-ted by that time, the respondents 1 to 5 shall appear before this Court.w - s
